note: Read 2026-11-01 at the owner's word ("Build those first 3 starting with ledger first"; of the 21 countries read first: "It should cover across every country"; "Retry the blocked tax facts once all countries land"): the tax on a screen worker's pay in Honduras: a resident's income tax, social contributions, what is withheld at source, a non-resident artiste's withholding, an author's treatment, VAT and the tax year. Research and retry subagents (workbench/briefs/BRIEF-tax.md, BRIEF-tax-retry.md), every quote checked by the lead against its saved page.

figures.finding: A resident's Honduran-source income is exempt up to HNL 228,324.32 a year, then taxed at 15% to 348,154.10, 20% to 809,660.75 and 25% above; a municipal personal tax of HNL 1.50 to 5.25 per thousand of income is withheld once a year by employers with five or more staff.

sources.said: Companies who have five or more employees have to withhold this tax once every year as follows:

figures.finding: The tax period is the calendar year; only self-employed people paid fees, commissions or royalties (and those with interest or rent) file returns.

sources.said: The tax period in Honduras is the 12-month period ended on 31 December.
Only self-employed individuals who receive commissions, fees, royalties, or other forms of income for services rendered and those who receive interest or rental income must file a tax return.

figures.finding: The employee pays 2.5% for sickness and maternity and 1% for invalidity, old age and death on pay up to HNL 11,903.13 a month; the employer pays 1% to INFOP.
figures.applies: 2026; employer IHSS shares not stated by the source.

sources.said: Sickness and maternity: 2.5% for employees on income up to a maximum ceiling of HNL 11,903.13 Invalidity, old age, and death: 1% from employees on income up to a maximum ceiling of HNL 11,903.13
INFOP contributions are assessed at a rate of 1% for employers.

figures.finding: The employer withholds income tax monthly from salaries.

sources.said: Employees who receive salaries and other similar or complementary remunerations or benefits must pay a monthly income tax that is withheld by the employer from the monthly payroll.

figures.finding: A non-resident's pay or other remuneration for services, and royalties, from Honduran sources bear 25% withholding by the payer.

sources.said: Salaries paid for services and other remuneration for rendering of services within national territory or abroad 25
the tax on any type of income paid to a non-resident must be withheld by the payer.

figures.finding: Sales tax is 15% (18% on some premium services).

sources.said: The general sales tax rate is 15% (18% for some specific premium services).

figures.finding: SAR's 2026 table, indexed by 2025 inflation of 4.98%: net taxable income to L228,324.32 a year (L22,360.36 a month) is exempt, then 15% to L348,154.10, 20% to L809,660.75 and 25% above.
figures.applies: Natural persons, tax year 2026; read by OCR of SAR's own notice image (digits checked against PwC's held figures).

figures.finding: Honduran-source income of a non-resident bears a final rate by kind: 25% on pay or any compensation for services, on public shows, on films and TV rights and on copyright royalties; 10% on most other income.
figures.applies: Art. 5 of the Ley del Impuesto sobre la Renta as SAR states it.
